title: February 2027 MSc intake for international applicants
summary: Warsaw University of Technology accepts applications for its February 2027 international MSc intake from 2 November 2026. Applicants need a bachelor's degree in a related field. Qualified applicants submit the separate admission documents by 20 January 2027. Classes begin on 22 February 2027. Check the university's requirements for the chosen programme and any special procedures.

evidence: February MSc intake published by the International Students Office
